settings_help.source: (bool) - What happens to the original images once their pixels are in fov.ome.zarr. On (the default): after a field is committed and every channel plane is verified byte for byte against its original, its originals are moved into orig/ in the project folder. Off: they are deleted after that check, which cannot be undone; each stored z slice is checked against its own file, and a field whose channels had different z slices is stored projected, so its originals go to orig/. A run cut short never loses an image. With 'npy' or 'tiff' runs, orig/ is deleted at the end only when off. Default True.

(bool) - The older switch for the original images. Off acts as keep_original_images off: with fov.ome.zarr each original is deleted only after its field is committed and verified there; with 'npy' or 'tiff' runs the raw images are deleted once they are in stack/, as before, which is not reversible. Use keep_original_images instead. Default True.

(bool) - When the source folder holds images of several plates (read from the file names by the Mask filename pattern), move each plate's images into its own folder inside it and analyse each as its own project with its own fov.ome.zarr. The run first prints a dry-run list (all of it in spacr_plate_split_plan.tsv), never overwrites a file, and checks every file's size and each folder's file count after the moves. Off (the default): a folder of several plates stops the run with that list and nothing is moved. The GUI asks before it splits. Default False.

(bool) - Keep the run's working masks/ folders after every field is merged. Off by default: they are removed once each field is committed to fov.ome.zarr (or merged/ for 'npy' runs), which holds the channels and every mask. With fov.ome.zarr no stack/ or masks/ folder is written: the channels and the masks of every stage go straight into the field (the small run records to fov.ome.zarr/.spacr_mask_run); kept, those labels are reused by a rerun, otherwise a rerun segments again. Older projects' stack/ folders are still read, and kept or removed by this setting as before.

(str) - Where Mask Generation keeps the fields Measure reads. 'ome-zarr' stores each field in fov.ome.zarr in the project folder: the acquired channels in their own dtype (no stack/ folder) and the masks of every stage as label images (no masks/ folder); no merged/*.npy is written. 'npy' writes stack/*.npy and merged/*.npy as before; 'tiff' adds merged_tiff/<field>.tif and <field>_<object>_mask.tif. Timelapse frames go on a t axis, z slices on a z axis (projected when read). Older layouts (stack/, masks/, merged/*.npy, images/<plate>.ome.zarr) still read. Default 'ome-zarr'. Alpha.
